name: The Ragged Spur
region_detail: A secluded dry creek bed beneath an eroded sandstone bluff.
site_type: hideout | Faction strongholds | Temporary Red Reins remount camp and stock enclosure.
history: An independent horse breaker once maintained a small corral and shelter in the creek bed. The site was abandoned after the well failed. Former Galrothe cavalrymen later discovered that its steep banks screened horses and riders from travelers crossing the open plains.
current_state: A Red Reins detachment periodically uses the corral to rest mounts, conceal stolen horses, and arrange their onward movement. Water and provisions must be brought in, so the camp is rarely occupied for more than a few days. Its use may change rapidly following a successful raid or discovery by the authorities.
inhabitants: Intermittent Red Reins riders, horse handlers, and stolen or spare mounts. The detachment's strength and leader are undetermined.
danger_level: Moderate when occupied; potentially high if a larger raiding party is present.
points_of_interest:
Screened corral; ruined horse breaker's shelter; dry well; tack and branding equipment; cached provisions; narrow stock trail leading out of the creek bed.

Unresolved elements: Which horses and riders are present when the location is visited.; Whether the camp is one of several similar remount stations.; The next destination of any stolen horses.; Whether the site is abandoned, reoccupied, or repurposed after discovery.
discovery: A secluded dry creek bed beneath an eroded sandstone bluff. Unrecognized horse brands, testimony from former cavalrymen, or reports of riders carrying water into the creek bed may lead to the camp. Following a stolen herd is another possible means of discovery.
